summary: More than most people, you swing between deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a strong will and deep reserves of energy, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you read people and care on instinct; other days your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: More than most people, you swing between deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a strong will and deep reserves of energy, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you read people and care on instinct; other days your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. The work is holding both without picking a side. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity. Emotions may move quickly here. Care, anger, and instinct can sit close together, which can make reactions feel immediate and hard to separate.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need — or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways.
integration: Let emotional needs and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
